title: Throwback Brewery
specs: Yankee Magazine Editor's Pick (Annual Travel Guide)
blurb: Throwback Brewery is dedicated to crafting delicious, farm-fresh beers and food sourced locally. They offer a variety of beers including pale ales, lagers, and schwarzbiers. The brewery values sustainability, community orientation, kindness, and excellence.
